en.title: PragAlign: Feedback-Guided Pragmatic Alignment for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation
en.hook: Explore a novel technique for generating natural, intent-preserving synthetic dialogues in privacy-restricted settings.
key_takeaways: Preserves communicative intent and affective meaning
Optimizes dialogue flow via feedback-guided alignment
Enhances synthetic data utility for privacy-sensitive services

zh.hook: 了解如何在隐私受限的环境中生成自然且保留意图的合成对话。
key_takeaways: 保持交际意图和情感意义
通过反馈引导的对齐优化对话流程
在隐私敏感的服务场景中应用合成数据
